## Description

Construct core collections using the information measure ‘Length of
Encoded Attribute Values’ (LEAV) using qualitative and/or quantitative
trait data as described by Balakrishnan and Suresh (2001a)
\<<https://indianjournals.com/article/ijpgr-14-1-006>\> and (2001b)
\<<https://indianjournals.com/article/ijpgr-14-3-005>\>.

## Installation

The package can be installed from CRAN as follows:

The development version can be installed from github as follows:

``` r

# Install development version from Github
devtools::install_github("aravind-j/LEAVcore")
```

## What’s new

To know whats new in this version type:

``` r

news(package='LEAVcore')
```

## Citing `LEAVcore`

To cite the methods in the package use:

``` r

citation("LEAVcore")
```

``` R
To cite the R package 'LEAVcore' in publications use:

  Aravind, J., Roy, S., and Singh, A. M. (2026).  LEAVcore: Constitution of Core Collections using
  Length of Encoded Attribute Values. R package version 0.1.0.9000,
  https://aravind-j.github.io/LEAVcore/https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=LEAVcore.

A BibTeX entry for LaTeX users is

  @Manual{,
    title = {LEAVcore: Constitution of Core Collections using Length of Encoded Attribute Values},
    author = {J. Aravind and Suman Roy and Anju Mahendru Singh},
    note = {R package version 0.1.0.9000 https://aravind-j.github.io/LEAVcore/ https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=LEAVcore},
    year = {2026},
  }

This free and open-source software implements academic research by the authors and co-workers. If you
use it, please support the project by citing the package.
```

# Package index

## Constitute Core Collection

- [`LEAVcore1()`](https://aravind-j.github.io/LEAVcore/reference/LEAVcore_functions.md)
  [`LEAVcore2()`](https://aravind-j.github.io/LEAVcore/reference/LEAVcore_functions.md)
  [`LEAVcore3()`](https://aravind-j.github.io/LEAVcore/reference/LEAVcore_functions.md)
  : Generate Core collections with Length of Encoded Attribute Values

## Estimate Information Measures

- [`inflen.qual()`](https://aravind-j.github.io/LEAVcore/reference/inflen.qual.md)
  : Compute Information Length for Qualitative Traits
- [`inflen.quant()`](https://aravind-j.github.io/LEAVcore/reference/inflen.quant.md)
  : Compute Information Length for Quantitative Traits
- [`LEAV()`](https://aravind-j.github.io/LEAVcore/reference/LEAV.md) :
  Compute the Length of Encoded Attribute Values

## Helpers

- [`prop.adj()`](https://aravind-j.github.io/LEAVcore/reference/prop.adj.md)
  : Relative Frequency Adjustments
- [`round_preserve_sum()`](https://aravind-j.github.io/LEAVcore/reference/round_preserve_sum.md)
  : Round Numeric Values While Preserving a Target Sum
